content:
Apple yesterday released the new 27.2 developer beta, and public beta testers can also download the latest update today. The following is the new content of the iPadOS 27.2 public beta 2 and other versions.

The latest 27.2 beta brings design updates and hidden new features to Apple TV 4K and HomePod

If you are a member of the Apple Public Beta Program (beta.apple.com), Apple is rolling out new beta updates today.

The iPadOS 27.2 public beta 2 is now available for download, and versions including tvOS 27.2 and HomePod 27.2 are also being rolled out.

These released software versions are identical to the developer beta 3 pushed to developers yesterday.

Some of the smaller changes debuting in today's beta include design updates to Apple Books, a redesigned Apple Music logo, as well as splash screens in some apps showcasing features we previously reported on.

More notably, the code in the latest beta reveals new features expected to be announced next week for the Apple TV 4K and HomePod. However, public beta users cannot see these features yet, as they are currently hidden in the code, awaiting Apple's official announcement.

In case you missed the related news, Apple is expected to hold new product launches again next week and in late October.

Have you installed the iPadOS 27.2 or other public beta 2 versions? Have you discovered any new features? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.

Featured iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV accessories

  • AirPods Pro 3 (currently on sale for $179, original price $249)
  • Portable Apple Watch USB-C charger
  • 100W USB-C fast charging power adapter
  • Anti-slip silicone case for Siri Remote, compatible with AirTag
  • HomeKit smart plug four-pack set
